svg.title: Spead AI Pro for WIKA: data model
svg.desc: perusahaan: A company (tenant) with its domain, installed packages such as tender review, and settings. unit / posisi / pengguna: Unit tree, positions with level and type, and people with role, unit, position and two-step settings. label / label_sasaran: Access labels and their targets: everyone, a unit with sub-units, a position or a level. berkas: A stored file: collection (project or reference), file role and appendix letter, confidentiality, approval, labels and versions. proyek / anggota_proyek: A tender project with employer, tender number, location, owning unit and members. tinjauan / butir_tinjauan: A versioned review of a package and its items, each with quote and summary segments, clause references and verification status. pekerjaan: A background job with its stage, progress and error, used by reviews and studio generation. analisa: A Doc Assistant analysis with its sources, result blocks and runs. studio_dokumen / studio_template / studio_kop: Studio documents, templates with versions, and letterheads, plus routes, numbering books and signatures. konektor_sambungan / konektor_aksi_tertunda: Connector connections with their policy, and data-changing actions waiting for approval. kuota_periode / buku_pemakaian: Quota periods and an append-only usage ledger. riwayat: Append-only audit history of who did what, protected by database rules.
